title: 5c-9: convention-aware orient integration
description:
## Parent

sutra/57 — 5c PRD: convention system design

## What to build

Assemble convention-aware orientation responses for agents. When an agent asks about a component/file scope, serve preferred conventions with templates, anti-pattern warnings, drift alerts, and waiver context.

Key pieces:
- Orient module that pulls from all convention subsystems: preferred conventions (with templates), deprecated/forbidden warnings, drift alerts, active waivers in scope
- Lifecycle state determines messaging: descriptive = "observed pattern" (informational), preferred = "follow this" + template, deprecated = "avoid this", forbidden = "anti-pattern"
- Integration with existing MCP tools (sutra_impact or new sutra_orient) to include convention data in orientation responses
- Pending lifecycle proposals surfaced as "sutra suggests promoting/deprecating X"

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Orientation response includes preferred conventions with templates for the target component
- [ ] Deprecated/forbidden conventions surfaced as warnings
- [ ] Drift alerts included when component shows rising entropy
- [ ] Waived violations in scope noted in orientation
- [ ] Pending proposals surfaced
- [ ] Descriptive conventions shown as informational only (no violation language)
- [ ] Convention data accessible via MCP tool

## Blocked by

- sutra/61 (per-component convention discovery)
- sutra/62 (propose-and-confirm lifecycle)
- sutra/64 (waiver tracking)
- sutra/65 (structural templates)
